LanguageData.MAP_CerebrexTakeover.Letter.Label: Cerebrex core taken over
LanguageData.MAP_CerebrexTakeover.Letter.Text: {PAWN} has taken control of the Cerebrex core. The mechhive has accepted the new control link and entered an alliance with the colony. Its resources can now be requested through a comms console.
LanguageData.MAP_CerebrexTakeover.Credits: {PAWN} took control of the Cerebrex core and integrated the mechhive resource network into the colony's allocation system.
LanguageData.MAP_CerebrexTakeover.PurgeCreditsRespons: Each day, the mechhive produces allocatable resources equivalent to 2,000 credits and adds 2,000 credits. Assisting with the construction of mech nodes also frees additional supplies and grants credits.
